title: Financial Accountant
description:
We are looking for a diligent Financial Accountant to join our finance team in London and take shared ownership of the general ledger, month-end close and statutory reporting.

Your mission: You will ensure accurate, timely and compliant financial records under IFRS and UK GAAP, acting as a trusted point of contact for accounting matters across the group.

What you will do:
- Own the preparation of monthly, quarterly and year-end close, including journals, accruals and prepayments
- Perform balance sheet reconciliations, fixed asset accounting and intercompany matching
- Support statutory account preparation and the annual external audit process
- Maintain and improve processes and the chart of accounts within SAP FICO
- Partner with tax, treasury and FP&A colleagues on cross-functional deliverables

About you:
- Part-qualified or newly qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) or equivalent experience
- At least 4 years of experience in financial accounting within a corporate or professional services environment
- Solid working knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP reporting requirements
- Hands-on experience with SAP FICO and strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups

Nice to have: Exposure to consolidation tools and group reporting.

Work policy: Hybrid with an office in London and up to two days remote per week. We offer a collaborative environment, modern systems and genuine development prospects.

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
Our fast-growing technology company in Dublin is looking for an analytically minded FP&A Analyst to support leadership with reliable numbers, forecasts and decision-ready insight.

Your mission: You will sit at the intersection of numbers and strategy, building planning models, analysing variances and making financial dynamics tangible for the wider business.

What you will do:
- Support the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts across revenue, cost and cash
- Build and maintain financial models that underpin planning and scenario analysis
- Prepare monthly reporting, including plan-versus-actual variance analysis and commentary
- Develop dashboards and KPIs in Power BI for management and business partners
- Partner with sales, marketing and operations teams to inform commercial decisions

About you:
- Degree in finance, economics, accounting or a related field
- At least 2 years of experience in FP&A, commercial finance or management accounting
- Strong financial modeling capability and advanced Excel skills
- Experience with BI tools such as Power BI and ideally planning software such as Anaplan

Nice to have: SQL knowledge and experience in a SaaS or scale-up environment.

Work policy: Hybrid with a modern office in Dublin and flexible remote days. We offer steep learning curves, direct access to leadership and real ownership.

title: Internal Auditor / Risk & Compliance Analyst
description:
The group internal audit function of an international insurance group in New York is looking for a thorough Internal Auditor with a focus on risk and compliance.

Your mission: You will examine processes, controls and systems, surface risks and deliver actionable recommendations to strengthen the internal control environment.

What you will do:
- Plan and execute risk-based audits across financial and business processes
- Assess the effectiveness of the internal control system and SOX-relevant controls
- Perform data analytics to detect anomalies and exceptions using ACL and Excel
- Produce clear audit reports and track remediation of agreed actions
- Collaborate with business units, external auditors and the compliance function

About you:
- Degree in accounting, finance, economics or a related field
- At least 3 years of experience in internal audit, external audit or risk management
- Working knowledge of SOX, internal controls and risk-based audit methodologies
- Analytical mindset and experience with data analytics tools such as ACL

Nice to have: Certifications such as CIA or CISA and experience in the insurance sector.

Work policy: Onsite with an office in New York, with limited flexibility. We offer an international environment, varied audit topics and clear development paths.

title: Tax Manager
description:
The corporate headquarters of a manufacturing group in Chicago is looking for an experienced Tax Manager to own tax matters and work closely with treasury.

Your mission: You will steer the group's tax strategy, ensure compliance across multiple jurisdictions and, together with treasury, optimize liquidity and group financing.

What you will do:
- Own ongoing tax advisory, tax returns and the management of tax audits
- Calculate and account for deferred tax under IFRS and US GAAP and support group tax reporting
- Manage transfer pricing and cross-border tax matters
- Partner with treasury on cash management, hedging and group financing
- Act as the point of contact for tax authorities, advisors and external auditors

About you:
- Degree with a focus on tax, accounting or a CPA / equivalent tax qualification
- At least 6 years of experience in corporate tax, ideally with treasury exposure
- Strong knowledge of domestic and international tax law and of US GAAP and IFRS
- Confident with SAP and common tax and treasury systems

Nice to have: Experience with transfer pricing and treasury management systems.

Work policy: Hybrid with an office in Chicago and flexible remote days. We offer a responsible key role with an international scope and direct reporting into finance leadership.

title: Financial Controller
description:
An established banking institution in Manchester is looking for an assertive Financial Controller to own financial steering and support leadership with reliable analysis.

Your mission: You will be a sparring partner for senior management, own the controlling framework and provide transparency over results, cost and profitability.

What you will do:
- Own operational and strategic controlling as well as management reporting
- Lead the budgeting and forecasting process in partnership with business units
- Analyse cost centres, contribution margins and the profitability of business lines
- Evolve reporting structures and build dashboards in Power BI
- Ensure alignment between controlling and financial accounting under IFRS

About you:
- Degree in finance, accounting or economics, and ideally a qualification such as ACA, ACCA or CIMA
- At least 7 years of experience in controlling or financial planning, including a leadership role
- Strong knowledge of financial modeling, IFRS and modern reporting tools
- Confident with SAP FICO and business intelligence tools such as Power BI

Nice to have: Experience in financial services and with planning software such as Anaplan.

Work policy: Hybrid with an office in Manchester and up to two days remote per week. We offer a hands-on leadership role with high visibility and a long-term perspective.
